watches.name: Radia Trinity Yellow - Vintage
watches.description: It's finally here - Radia's first field watch - Trinity. Experience the perfect fusion of style and functionality with our stunning yellow radial brushed dial. Powered by a premium automatic movement with 24 jewels it runs at 28 800 bph. Aesthetic dial with characteristic 3-dots on top uses applied indices with Swiss SuperLuminova C3 and BGW9. It comes with a top hat double dome sapphire crystal that makes the light add another dimension to this piece. All this is closed in 200m WR brushed case that is sized to 38,5mm which makes this model very comfortable to wear. SPECIFICATION: Movement: Miyota 9039 High Beat Automatic Power Reserve: 42h Anti-Shock System: Parashock Hacking: Yes Crystal: Top Hat Double Dome Sapphire AR: Double AR Inner Coating Lume: Swiss SuperLuminova C3 and BGW9 Indices: Applied Indices Case: Extra Hardened 316l Stainless Steel (>1000HV) With Anti-Fingerprint Film Strap: Vintage Genuine Leather Strap With Quick-Release System Water Resistance: 200m/20atm/656ft Crown: Screw Down Crown Details: Branded Buckle and Crown Caseback: Solid Case Diameter: 38.5mm Lug-to-Lug: 46.5mm Lug Width: 20mm Thickness: 12mm (including top hat sapphire) Warranty: 24 months This is highly limited edition. For orders outside of EU additional customs fees and taxes may apply.

watches.name: Radia RBMK Black
watches.description: The RBMK watch is designed to serve as a reminder of the events and causes of the 1986 Chernobyl disaster, reflecting the era in which these significant events occurred. It is distinguished by a sophisticated, original pattern and a unique cut on the dial. Luminous markers highlight its connection to nuclear energy and radiation. The watch is powered by a durable mechanism that has been on the market for decades, ensuring reliability and ease of service. Each watch comes with a free battery, already installed. We're helping: 10% of the profits from sales of this model on our website will be donated to Polska Akcja Humanitarna (Polish Humanitarian Action) to support Ukraine. Case: Stainless Steel 316l PVD Matte Black Coated Diameter: 40mm Glass: Sapphire Dial: Black Dial details: Soft lume hands and markers Back: Chernobyl reactor engraved Strap: Black military style nylon Water resistance: 5ATM (50 meters / 164 feet) Movement: Miyota Japanese Quartz Cal. 2115 Battery: SR626SW (gratis: included & installed) Warranty: 2 Years (warranty does not cover battery life)
